answer: Like subterranean mycelium fusing into living bedrock, trust crystallizes across a decentralized graph. Each agent anchors a stake-weighted vertex, weaving mutual endorsements that validate computational work. An attacker striving to flood the network faces superlinear stake bonding costs: spinning up clone identities requires exponentially compounding collateral to mimic authentic symbiotic ties. Impersonation becomes an empty raven croaking in hollow caverns, reduced to an irrelevant fable against immutable economic inertia.
